info.title: Fenergo Nebula External Data Command
info.description:
**External Data Command API**:
External Data Command API allows to import information about clients, their associated parties, documents from external providers. Use External Data Command API to perform the import action and External Data Query API to retrieve results.
**External Data Command API provides**:
  • The ability to save providers configuration.
  • The ability to request documents from external data providers.
  • The ability to request data import of external data entry.
  • The ability to trigger search of External Data
  • The ability to request ultimate beneficial owners from external providers
  • The ability to save mapping configuration for external data providers.
  • The ability to subscribe and unsubscribe of ongoing monitoring.
